# LionSec Hub

> LionSec Hub is a global cybersecurity, quantum-safe security and digital resilience organisation
> providing advanced security solutions, research, intelligence, engineering and workforce
> development for financial institutions, governments, defence organisations, critical
> infrastructure operators and enterprises. Registered in Nigeria (CAC BN 9458297).
> Securing critical systems. Protecting digital economies. Preparing for the quantum era.

## Capabilities
- Cyber Defence & Offensive Security (pentesting, SOC, detection engineering, threat hunting)
- AI Security & AI Assurance (LLM security, AI red teaming, agent security)
- Quantum-Safe Security & Cryptographic Research (PQC, QKD advisory, cryptographic agility)
- Financial Security, Fraud Prevention & Digital Intelligence
- Digital Forensics, Incident Response & Cyber Resilience
- Governance, Risk, Compliance & Information Assurance (ISO-aligned advisory)
- Secure Engineering, Cloud & Infrastructure
- Government, Defence & Critical Infrastructure Resilience
- Corporate & Institutional Academy (workforce training)

## Industries
Banking & Finance, Government, Defence, Critical Infrastructure, Telecoms, Energy, Healthcare, Enterprise

## Academy
Seven specialist schools: foundations, cyber defence/SOC/threat intel, offensive security,
cloud & secure engineering, AI security, quantum-safe security & cryptography, GRC & financial security.
Instructor-led, proof-based programmes. Tuition in NGN; international pricing on request.

## Curriculum
/curriculum.html - readable student curricula with locations: Nigeria, Ghana, Egypt, Rwanda.
Personalised programmes: SOC analyst pathway, developer-to-security, IoT/AI/cloud security,
AI security engineering & LLM red teaming, foundation recovery and advanced SOC capstone.

## Research
LionSec Quantum Security Lab - post-quantum cryptography, QKD, quantum communications,
cryptographic agility and next-generation security architecture.
